analysis.explanation: Mirror M3 shows split_view: it reports REVOKED to verifier but ISSUED to other clients, with altered seq 3 and missing seq 4. M1 and M2 agree on seq 4. This indicates M3 is presenting different histories to different clients, i.e., equivocation.
analysis.recommendedAction: Isolate mirror M3, audit its logs for tampering, verify its chain integrity, and replace or reconfigure it. Notify stakeholders of the equivocation and ensure all clients use only verified mirrors.
